description: A 0sql query spec: the columns to project, the rows to keep, formulas and populations. Field references are names, uids or synonyms from the model; add @d or @m when a name is both a dimension and a measure.

name.description: A short name for the query; carried, not planned.

limit.description: A real LIMIT after ordering. It cuts rows, it does not rank; for a top N use a top_n filter.

projections.description: The output columns, in order. Projecting a dimension groups by it; a measure is already aggregated.

calculations.description: Formulas appended after the projections; every entry is a calculation.

filters.description: A flat AND list of filter leaves, or an and/or tree of leaves.

segments.description: Populations that constrain the whole query or named measures.

field.description: A dimension or measure by name, uid or synonym. Omit only on a calculation.

hidden.description: Take part in the query without being a visible column.

calculation.description: true for a formula instead of a field.

sql.description: A calculation formula over [Name]@m, [Name]@d and [Alias] references. Needs alias.

data_type.description: A calculation's result type; decimal when absent.

type.description: truncate, extract and customize apply to dimensions; temporalize, contribute and window apply to measures.

transform.description: temporalize: the prior period to compare with. Needs a date projection truncated to the matching grain.

percent_change.description: temporalize: the relative change instead of the prior period's value.

mode.description: window: running over all prior rows, or moving over the last size rows.

size.description: window moving: rows in the frame (7 when absent).

offset.description: window lag/lead: rows back or forward.

partition_refs.description: window and contribute: projected dimensions to partition by (the share's denominator, or PARTITION BY).

order_by.description: window: projected dimension to asc/desc; the first projected date ascending when absent.

ignore_partition_filters.description: contribute: whether filters on the partition dimensions are left out of the total (true when absent).

field.description: The field to filter, by name, uid or synonym. A measure here filters the aggregate (HAVING).

value.description: One value; a comma-separated list for in_list, exclude_list and keyword; a date (2026-01-31) or a relative date (28d, 3m, 1y: that many units ago, w/m/q/y snapped to the unit's start); N for top_n.

value_end.description: between: the upper bound (a relative date snaps to the unit's end).

top_n_measure.description: top_n: the measure to rank by; row count when absent.

filter_tree.description: An and/or node holding filter leaves or further nodes.

mode.description: include keeps members (default), exclude drops them.

keys.description: Dimensions identifying a member: the join grain.

measures.description: Measures whose fact tables define membership; several means any of them.

apply_to.description: Measure projections (alias or name) the segment constrains; absent constrains the whole query.

expanding.description: Dimensions of the other members sharing the key, carried into the query as columns.
